notes: RSS/Atom feeds verified to return valid XML (HTTP 200) on 2026-11-23. The daily routine reads these, picks the top builder-relevant items from the last 72 hours, and appends entries to curated.json. Never republish full article text: store headline, a 2-sentence original takeaway, source, date and the outbound URL only. Descriptions are short editorial blurbs of what each source covers, used on /news and /news/sources.
